h1: When do you need to file an RDA or NOI with the Newton Conservation Commission?
title: Newton Conservation Commission Filings: RDA and NOI Applications
description: Compare the application materials Newton lists for a Request for Determination of Applicability and a Notice of Intent.
short_answer: Newton uses a Request for Determination of Applicability (RDA) and a Notice of Intent (NOI) as separate wetlands filing paths. The City lists a $50 filing fee for each application type. An NOI requires additional materials, including scaled plans, a project narrative, performance-standard information, and abutter-notification documents.

facts.text: Newton lists an RDA Process Instructions and Checklist, WPA Form 1, scaled plans, and a $50 City filing fee as RDA application materials.
Newton lists WPA Form 3, scaled plans, a project narrative, performance-standard information, a $50 filing fee, and abutter-notification documents among NOI application materials.

qa.q: Does an RDA require the same submission package as an NOI?
qa.a: No. Newton lists different filing materials for the two application types. The City should confirm which filing applies to the proposed activity.

items: Whether the project requires an RDA, NOI, or another determination
